rationale: The supplied implementations do not appear to be matching versions of the documented function: the vulnerable fragment contains part of read_quant_matrix_ext, whereas the fixed fragment is decode_vop_header and contains no quantization-matrix read. The Logic claim that the function checks for enough bits before reading a quantization matrix is not supported by the shown vulnerable fragment, but it also cannot be unambiguously attributed to the fixed implementation because its bit-availability check concerns a different header field. Therefore the apparent fixed-specific validation wording cannot be reliably classified as a version-disclosing leak from this pair.
